title: Switch PulseAudio output port
summary: Manually switch the active port on a sound card, such as switching between speakers and headphones. This is useful if automatic switching fails.

steps.explain: Set the active port for a sink. Replace <SINK_INDEX> with the sink index and <PORT_NAME> with the port name (e.g., analog-output-headphones).

placeholders.name: SINK_INDEX
placeholders.description: The index of the output device.

placeholders.name: PORT_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the port, e.g., 'analog-output-headphones'.
